# RT-1 TokenLearner 空间汇聚

## 1. 问题

RT-1 TokenLearner 空间汇聚：实现下列接口并通过数值、边界和实验检查。

提取视觉token压缩器；MLP注意力logits作为输入，不训练EfficientNet、Transformer或真实机器人。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
Z_{bkc}=\sum_l\operatorname{softmax}_l(S_{blk})X_{blc}.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `token_learner_pool(features: Tensor, logits: Tensor) -> Tensor`

将logits转成(B,K,L)，沿最后维归一化后乘原始features。每个学习token是一组空间凸组合，不能沿K归一化，也不应对被汇聚features再次做LayerNorm。

## 4. 本题约定

features为(B,L,C)，logits为(B,L,K)；只沿空间L做softmax。输出(B,K,C)，两输入均保留梯度。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

`experiment.py` 在固定输入上调用提交的全部接口，记录学习或采样曲线与末端指标。实验逻辑和阈值见 T3，输出同样用于可视化。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.06817) — Official tokenizers/token_learner.py: spatial softmax and einsum over original features
- [Verified source](https://github.com/google-research/robotics_transformer/blob/master/tokenizers/token_learner.py)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。

先按公式确定归约轴、有效掩码和梯度路径，再将手算小例与实现逐项比较。测试中的独立预期值不调用参考答案。

## 测试捕获的错误

- Softmax normalizes learned tokens rather than spatial positions.
- The learned spatial weights are discarded.

## 实验范围

提取视觉token压缩器；MLP注意力logits作为输入，不训练EfficientNet、Transformer或真实机器人。

## 可重复实验记录

3个空间patch、1个token，目标汇聚值0.8；分数从零开始，100步梯度下降(lr=1)。要求MSE<初始0.1%。

判题固定seed=42。计算采用CPU float64、显式输入，涉及优化时使用普通梯度更新；不下载数据集或模型权重。原生PyTorch与真实Pyodide/NumPy-WASM执行同一套T0–T3测试。阈值针对本教学实验。

en.title: RT-1 TokenLearner Spatial Pooling
en.readme:
# RT-1 TokenLearner Spatial Pooling

## 1. Exercise goal

RT-1 TokenLearner Spatial Pooling: implement the interfaces below and verify numerical, boundary and experimental behavior.

Isolate visual-token compression with supplied MLP attention logits; omit EfficientNet, the Transformer and physical robots.

## 2. Core equations

$$
Z_{bkc}=\sum_l\operatorname{softmax}_l(S_{blk})X_{blc}.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `token_learner_pool(features: Tensor, logits: Tensor) -> Tensor`

Transpose logits to (B,K,L), normalize the last axis, and multiply the original features. Each learned token is a spatial convex combination; normalizing K or pooling normalized features changes the operator.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Features are (B,L,C), logits (B,L,K); softmax only over spatial L. Return (B,K,C), preserving gradients of both inputs.

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

`experiment.py` calls every submitted interface on fixed inputs and records a learning or sampling curve and terminal metrics. T3 states the behavioral thresholds; the visualization uses the same outputs.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.06817) — Official tokenizers/token_learner.py: spatial softmax and einsum over original features
- [Verified source](https://github.com/google-research/robotics_transformer/blob/master/tokenizers/token_learner.py)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.
